import http.server, ssl, subprocess, pathlib, sys

cert_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

if not key.exists() or not crt.exists():

        "openssl","req","-newkey","rsa:2048","-nodes","-keyout",str(key),
        "-x509","-days","365","-out",str(crt),"-subj","/CN=localhost"
    ], check=True)

handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler

import struct, subprocess, sys

binary = "./vuln"
offset = 0               # set with cyclic/find offset
badchars = b"\x00\x0a\x0d"

def cyclic_find(crash_eip):

    return cyclic_find(crash_eip)

def pack64(val): return struct.pack("<Q", val)

def build_rop():
